title: WESTGATE — NIGHT SHIFT
hook: You're alone on night shift at Westgate Mall.
question: So… what would you do?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.style: Calm, cold, cinematic horror narrator. Soft and clear.
lines.text: You're alone on night shift… at Westgate Mall.
lines.caption: You're alone on night shift at Westgate Mall.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two seventeen A.M. The food-court motion sensor just blinked once.
lines.caption: 2:17 AM. The food-court sensor blinked.

lines.speaker: you
lines.style: Anxious whisper into a radio mic, trying to sound professional.
lines.text: Dispatch… anyone copy? I've got movement in the food court.
lines.caption: Dispatch… anyone copy?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No answer. So what do you do?
lines.caption: No answer. So what do you do?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You take the corridor. Flashlight up. Every shuttered store feels like it's watching.
lines.caption: You take the corridor. Flashlight up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The food court is empty. Then a tray scrapes… by itself.
lines.caption: A tray scrapes… by itself.

lines.speaker: thing
lines.style: Wrong cheerful whisper, too close to the mic, smiling.
lines.caption: Ready for your break?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three smiling staff stand where the cameras said nothing was. Your radio dies.
lines.caption: Your radio dies.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.style: Neutral reset, like a game rewind.
lines.caption: REWIND

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You stay at the desk. You radio it in. Still nothing.
lines.caption: You stay. You radio it in.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Cameras show your chair empty… while you're still sitting in it.
lines.caption: Cameras show your chair empty.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Footsteps in the dark corridor. You follow your own flashlight beam.
lines.caption: You follow your own flashlight beam.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Staff-only door ajar. The LED panel flips from ALL CLEAR… to SEE YOU.
lines.caption: ALL CLEAR… becomes SEE YOU.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Inside: name tags, a safety card, and faces that weren't hired for this mall.
lines.caption: Faces that weren't hired for this mall.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.style: Soft, inviting a comment, cold smile in the voice.
lines.caption: So… what would you do?
